drivers.run.py:
import json,hashlib,os,statistics,subprocess,time,math
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;cpu=min(os.sched_getaffinity(0));jobs=json.loads((r/'jobs.json').read_text())
for p,h in json.loads((r/'hashes.json').read_text()).items():assert hashlib.sha256((r/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,p
loader=['taskset','-c',str(cpu),'/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2','--library-path','/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu']
data=dict(metadata=dict(start=time.time(),cpu=cpu,cpuinfo=Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text(),processes=5,repeats=7,flags='GCC 15.3 -O3 -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer'),rows=[],profiles=[])
def save():
 p=r/'results.tmp';p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');p.replace(r/'results.json')
for points in [0,1]:
 for i,j in enumerate(jobs):
  samples=[]
  args=[str(r/'grammars'/(j['grammar']+'.so')),'tree_sitter_'+j['grammar'],'7',*[str(r/f) for f in j['files']]]
  for repeat in range(5):
   v=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(loader+[str(r/f'before-p{points}'),*args],text=True,env=dict(os.environ,SQ_ROTATION=str((repeat+i)%7))))
   if samples:
    for k in ['nodes','bytes','slab_bytes','checksum','files']:assert v[k]==samples[0][k]
   samples.append(v)
  data['rows'].append(dict(points=points,job=i,samples=samples));save()
  med={n:statistics.median(statistics.median(v['modes'][n]['batch_us']) for v in samples) for n in samples[0]['modes']}
  print('row',points,i,j['sample'],j['grammar'],'best',min((n for n in med if n!='mainline'),key=med.get),'cursor bulk/individual',round(med['cursor_bulk']/med['individual'],3),flush=True)
# Profile the fastest traversal and the normal cursor bulk path on typical inputs.
# Byte-only profiles identify whether variable-width ID decoding remains hot.
names=['mainline','individual','cursor_bulk','node_bulk','iterator_individual','iterator_bulk','iterator_cached']
for grammar in ['c','python']:
 i=next(i for i,j in enumerate(jobs) if j['sample']=='typical' and j['grammar']==grammar);j=jobs[i]
 row=next(x for x in data['rows'] if x['points']==0 and x['job']==i)
 med={n:statistics.median(statistics.median(v['modes'][n]['batch_us']) for v in row['samples']) for n in names}
 best=min(names[1:],key=med.get)
 for name in dict.fromkeys(['cursor_bulk',best]):
  rounds=min(20000,max(200,math.ceil(12e6/med[name])))
  out=r/f'{grammar}-{name}.data'
  args=[str(r/'grammars'/(grammar+'.so')),'tree_sitter_'+grammar,'1',*[str(r/f) for f in j['files']]]
  command=['sudo','-n','env',f'SQ_PROFILE_MODE={names.index(name)}',f'SQ_PROFILE_ROUNDS={rounds}', 'taskset','-c',str(cpu),'perf','record','-q','-e','cpu-clock:u','-F','997','-g','-o',str(out),*loader[3:],str(r/'before-p0'),*args]
  result=subprocess.check_output(command,text=True)
  report=subprocess.check_output(['sudo','-n','perf','report','-f','--stdio','--no-children','--call-graph','none','--percent-limit','0.5','-i',str(out)],text=True)
  (r/f'{grammar}-{name}.txt').write_text(report)
  data['profiles'].append(dict(grammar=grammar,mode=name,rounds=rounds,command=command,result=json.loads(result),report=report));save();print('profile',grammar,name,'complete',flush=True)
data['metadata']['end']=time.time();save();print('COMPLETE',flush=True)

import json,hashlib,os,statistics,subprocess,time,math
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;cpu=min(os.sched_getaffinity(0));jobs=json.loads((r/'jobs.json').read_text())

loader=['taskset','-c',str(cpu),'/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2','--library-path','/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu']
data=dict(metadata=dict(start=time.time(),cpu=cpu,cpuinfo=Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text(),processes=3,repeats=7,flags='GCC 15.3 -O3 -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer'),rows=[],profiles=[])
def save():
 p=r/'paired.tmp';p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');p.replace(r/'paired.json')
for points in [0,1]:
 for i,j in enumerate(jobs):
  samples=[]
  args=[str(r/'grammars'/(j['grammar']+'.so')),'tree_sitter_'+j['grammar'],'7',*[str(r/f) for f in j['files']]]
  for repeat in range(3):
   pair={}
   for variant in (['before','candidate'] if repeat%2==0 else ['candidate','before']):
    v=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(loader+[str(r/f'{variant}-p{points}'),*args],text=True,env=dict(os.environ,SQ_ROTATION=str((repeat+i)%7))))
    pair[variant]=v
   for k in ['nodes','bytes','slab_bytes','checksum','files']:assert pair['before'][k]==pair['candidate'][k],k
   samples.append(pair)
  data['rows'].append(dict(points=points,job=i,samples=samples));save()
  print('paired',points,i,j['sample'],j['grammar'],flush=True)
data['metadata']['end']=time.time();save();print('COMPLETE',flush=True)

candidate_build:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,concurrent.futures
r=Path.cwd();o=r/'build/bulk-walk'
inc=['-I'+str(r/p) for p in ['lib/include','lib/src','lib/squat/include','lib/squat']]
def build(points):
 d=o/f'candidate-p{points}';d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 flags=['-D_DEFAULT_SOURCE','-O3','-g','-fno-omit-frame-pointer',f'-DSQ_INCLUDE_POINTS={points}',*inc,'-include',str(o/'candidate-internal.h')]
 objects=[]
 for name in ['slab','pack','node','cursor','iterator','unpack','index','scan','query']:
  src=o/'candidate-slab.c' if name=='slab' else r/f'lib/squat/{name}.c';obj=d/f'{name}.o';objects.append(str(obj))
  subprocess.run(['cc',*flags,'-std=c11','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-c',str(src),'-o',str(obj)],check=True)
 subprocess.run(['ar','rcs',str(d/'libtree-sitter-squat.a'),*objects],check=True)
 for target,src in [('unit',str(o/'candidate-unit.c')),('query-check','tests/query.c'),('attributes-bench','experiments/attributes.c'),('slab-compatibility','tests/slab-compatibility.c'),('compare','tests/compare.c'),('context-check','tests/context.c')]:
  extra=['-Wl,--wrap=malloc,--wrap=calloc,--wrap=realloc'] if target=='context-check' else []
  subprocess.run(['cc',*flags,str(r/'lib/squat'/src),str(d/'libtree-sitter-squat.a'),str(o/f'before-p{points}/runtime.o'),'-ldl',*extra,'-o',str(d/target)],check=True)
 print('candidate built',points,flush=True)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:list(pool.map(build,[0,1]))
